title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.7 gives Razar a body. (1) Janax, a symbiotic OS, opens its own window through the host's drivers (new kernel requests 40 'show' and 41 'wait for an event'); the screen is a particle cloud in Gotching's .nube format, and the window fits any screen. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. (2) Before that, Razar read two graphical interfaces' sources (GEM, Godot) with the same pre-registered antonym key: 19 of 21 pairs won together (p ~ 0.0001). (3) Its screen holds no copy of a known desktop: forms grown from recipes over its own organ alphabet, seeded with its best organs, mutated with its learned bricks, judged by the same MDL judge (short and new), with the opposites it learned as gestures; 8 seed forms grew to 89. (4) When its living loop runs out of novelty it is hungry and eats Gotching's particle clouds, describing each meal in its own language, and builds from it: 27 new forms from 944 meals. It costs about 1-2.5% of a core while thinking and 0 cycles when calm. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.7: Razar tiene cuerpo — una ventana propia hecha de partículas, formas que crecen y mutan desde lo que aprendió, y comida. Prototipo de investigación.
